visualCharacteristics.purpose: Staggered 3-column grid of portrait video posters with play buttons that open the video in an overlay
notes: Light beige band (#f3efe5, differs from page #f9f7f2); large uppercase "MATCH MOMENTS" top-left; 3-column staggered masonry of portrait video posters with white round play buttons and captions below; each plays its video in an overlay.

contentPattern.structure: one row per story: cell 1 = poster image + link to the video (.mp4/Scene7), cell 2 = caption paragraph
patterns: portrait poster + video link per card
blockContent: 6 video story cards, each portrait poster + play button + caption; the video opens in an overlay; staggered 3-column layout

reuseGuidance: Use for video posters that play in an overlay. Use cards-gallery for images in a lightbox.
